question: What should one do if unable to perform yoga or divine action?
premises: Even if established in my yoga, if unable to do this, renounce all action-fruit and be self-controlled.
If unable to perform divine action from ignorance, renounce all that to me through self-offering according to scripture-stated method.
Relying on this intent, in easy procedure I alone said...
Whatever is deficient, excessive, unknown, lacking before/after, lacking attention, or a slip of intellect, forgive mercifully, O Shambhu, since you are full of compassion.
By this hymn-yoga I offer your self; again causelessly I attain fitness for sufferings.
In supreme lordly doctrinal scriptures, in self-offering this very intent; this meaning is summarized.
inference: Inability to perform yoga or divine action is remedied by renunciation, self-offering, and merciful forgiveness of faults.

plain_english: Even if you are established in my yoga but unable to do this, renounce the fruits of all actions and remain self-controlled. If, from ignorance, you cannot perform divine action, then renounce all of it to me through self-offering, according to the method stated in scripture. Relying on that intent, I have spoken in an easy procedure. Whatever is deficient, excessive, unknown, lacking sequence, lacking attention, or a slip of intellect, forgive mercifully, O Shambhu, since you are full of compassion. By this yoga of hymn I offer your self; again, causelessly, I attain fitness for sufferings. In the supreme lordly doctrinal scriptures, this very intent is that of self-offering; this meaning is summarized.
